Synthetic Kiro projects (no sample copied):

- `issue-triage`: Kiro's 2026 style — a Glossary, `WHEN x, THE Term SHALL y`, indented sub-tasks, an optional `[ ]*` task, a Checkpoint, a task ticked before speccoder ran, steering with and without front matter — `fileMatch`, `auto`, `manual`, and file references (`docs/style.md`, one outside the project).
- `photo-albums`: cc-sdd's style — `**Objective:**`, `WHEN … THEN the X SHALL`, `IF`, unindented sub-tasks, `(P)`, `_Depends:_`, free-text `_Requirements:_`, `spec.json`.
- `bugfix`: a bugfix spec — `bugfix.md` in Kiro's numbered, wrapped layout, `design.md`, and Kiro's own exploration/preservation/fix tasks with a parent and an optional one; the runtime tests put it over the bug fixture's seeded code.
